messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy 'v2026-03-20' to eu-west/us-west. Running preflight SLO smoke checks now. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/run/2237893456
priya: seeing a p95 spike and a small 5xx burst for embed-service in eu-west, current 5xx ~2.4% over 5m :eyes:
jamie: how long has it been elevated? can you paste the quick query?
leo: pulling logs/trace now. initial glance shows a burst around +00:02 into canary, lots of kv-cache misses for small batching traffic.
nina: autoscaler reports warm pool trim in eu-west at the same time, might be correlated. also seeing quantize-v2 kernel timeouts in a handful of hosts.
priya: recommend pausing traffic to eu-west and pinning model to previous stable (v2026-03-19-eu) while we triage. :pause_button:
jamie: agreed. pause canary for eu-west only, continue us-west. jamie: priya, can you trigger the region pin and quick smoke rollback?
priya: on it. pinning and redirecting 100% eu-west canary traffic -> v2026-03-19-eu now. will kick off a 10m smokecheck.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic for region eu-west paused and routed to pinned version v2026-03-19-eu. Canary status: PARTIAL_PAUSED. Audit: deploy/2237893456/pause/eu-west
oncall-bot: SLO alerts for eu-west suppressed for 15m during rollback window per runbook (reason: controlled rollback).
leo: attaching quick metrics snapshot below for context:
```text
sum(rate(service_embed_5xx_count[5m])) by(region) -> eu-west: 0.024 (2.4%), us-west: 0.003 (0.3%)
p95(service_embed_latency_ms){region="eu-west"} -> 820ms (baseline 420ms)
kv_cache_miss_rate{service="embed"} -> eu-west: 0.18 (baseline 0.08)
error_samples:
  - trace_id: abc123 -> model_infer: kernel_timeout
  - trace_id: def456 -> batch_flush: kv_miss
```
priya: smokecheck started. initial 2m looks stable on pinned version, 5xx back to 0.2% and p95 down to ~430ms :white_check_mark:
jamie: good. let's hold the pause 10m total to validate. if stable, we'll abort the canary rollout in eu-west and record release notes with the rollback.
nina: i'll check autoscaler warm pool config and node kernel logs for any crashloops. leaving a note to increase warm_pool_min next run.
leo: i'll collect affected host IDs and upload traces to the incident bucket; will create a short postmortem draft if we need full rollback across regions.
priya: updating release notes and notifying CS to expect a partial rollback for eu-west. sending heads-up to customers who had preview access.
jamie: solid. action items: leo — collect traces + upload (assigned), nina — autoscaler config check, priya — pin/notes + CS ping, jamie — follow up with model team after canary completes. Reopen thread when green or if errors recur. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary for eu-west remains paused. Will resume only on explicit unpause command.
priya: final smoke after 10m looks clean. I'm going to mark eu-west as STABLE on pinned version and abort canary in that region.
jamie: abort confirmed. leaving canary running in us-west per original rollout. we'll rerun a canary with adjusted warm_pool and kv-cache tuning tomorrow in a smaller batch. Thanks all. :tada:
